input.content: Search X (Twitter) since 2026-07-08 for posts mentioning any of: @aeonframework, aaronjmars/aeon, aeon framework autonomous agents, @miroshark_, MiroShark swarm simulation, built on aeon. For each post return: @handle, full text, date, whether author is a project/builder (from bio/links), engagement counts (likes/rts), and URL https://x.com/handle/status/ID. Focus on posts from project or builder accounts, not casual mentions. Ignore posts from @aaronjmars or @0xNurstar.
